_comment: REFERENCE config for the autonomous cadence — NOT auto-executed. Nothing here runs on its own yet. To make a loop live you must EITHER invoke the harness `/loop` skill on the skill (e.g. `/loop weekly /weekly-ops`) OR run these on an always-on host (a VPS cron calling Claude Code). This file documents the intended schedule + alerts so whoever wires the runner has a single source of truth. See ROADMAP.md backlog: 'always-on host' decision.

loops.name: dm-poll
loops._note: Every 5 min — only works with an always-on host (the DM webhook needs to be reachable too).

telegram._note: Create a Telegram bot, save token + chat id as env vars, set wired=true. Mirrors Romain's Telegram failure alerts.
